hard_exclusions.material_strategic_transaction: Acquisition, disposal, merger, buyout or restructuring announcement that changes consolidated scope or announces a material strategic transaction
hard_exclusions.ceo_succession_or_material_workforce_red: Chief executive succession or material workforce reduction announcement
hard_exclusions.material_legal_or_regulatory_action: New material litigation, criminal plea, export restriction or regulatory action
hard_exclusions.unresolved_common_share_basis: Split, reverse split, spinoff or other price-basis event with unresolved common share basis
hard_exclusions.duplicate_preliminary_earnings_or_guidan: A separate preliminary earnings or guidance disclosure in the observation window that duplicates or supersedes the economic event
hard_exclusions.unresolved_source_or_material_scope: Unknown provenance or unresolved material comparability is a hard exclusion, per the registered source-quality freeze rule.

soft_caveats.routine_share_repurchase_authorization: Routine share-repurchase authorization announced in the observation window
soft_caveats.routine_dividend_initiation_or_change: Routine dividend initiation or change announced in the observation window
soft_caveats.minor_board_or_officer_appointment: Minor board or officer appointment announced in the observation window, excluding chief executive succession

scope: 24 reviewed warmup pairs plus the exact 58 frozen held candidates. Hard scope comparisons also inspect the complete prior/current interval; competing-catalyst masks use prior close inclusive to feature cutoff exclusive.
limitations: This draft records event-level catalyst decisions from the named written evidence. Periodic 10-Q/10-K entries identified in regulatory_window_filings are metadata leads, not certifications that every statement in those filings was independently audited. This is a source mask review, not a corporate-action/share-basis clearance or price-label clearance. Missing findings do not establish comprehensive all-news coverage.
